summary.prose: Building Story s3 means adding one new orchestration module (outside review-round/) that supplies review-round's existing RoundDriverHooks.security adapter, drives two full review rounds through the shared runReviewRound machinery, and assembles s1's selected model plus s2's dependency advisories into one in-memory report -- with zero new code required inside review-round/ itself. The hardest part is runSecurityReview's own invariants: binding every nested helper to the explicit repoPath (never the ambient session repo) while preserving an already-bound trusted execution context, re-verifying contentIdentity three times across the review's lifetime, and persisting exactly one execution-auditability VerificationReceipt per round under a fresh per-call attemptId so a retry never silently overwrites a prior failure's evidence. The final piece wires sc3 -- the daemon IPC method + insrc_security_review_step MCP tool -- as the actual caller-invocable trigger this Epic previously left unassigned, mirroring insrc_code_review_step's stale-index confirm_wait/resume pattern.

tasks.title: Implement deriveReceiptIdentity, verifyContentIdentityMatch, and s3's new error/report types
tasks.summary: Add ContentIdentityMismatchError and SecurityModelUnavailableError (dataModelChanges), the in-memory SecurityReviewReport interface, deriveReceiptIdentity(contentIdentity) (pure, sha256-derived 16-hex epicHash + fixed 's1' storyId, tested through a real persistVerificationReceipt+readReceiptRecord round trip per the LLD's own postcondition), and verifyContentIdentityMatch(repoPath, targets, advisoryEvidence) (recomputes via computeContentIdentity, throws ContentIdentityMismatchError on a mismatch or on contentStable:false).
acceptanceChecks: deriveReceiptIdentity(contentIdentity) returns {epicHash, storyId:'s1'} where epicHash is exactly 16 lowercase hex characters derived deterministically from contentIdentity; the SAME contentIdentity always re-derives the identical pair, a different one derives a different pair
the derived identity round-trips through a REAL persistVerificationReceipt + readReceiptRecord call without being rejected by the storage layer's own id-shape checks
verifyContentIdentityMatch resolves silently when computeContentIdentity(repoPath, targets) === advisoryEvidence.contentIdentity and advisoryEvidence.contentStable is true
verifyContentIdentityMatch throws ContentIdentityMismatchError when the recomputed identity does not match advisoryEvidence.contentIdentity
verifyContentIdentityMatch throws ContentIdentityMismatchError when contentStable is false even though the identity strings match

tasks.title: Implement buildSecurityRoundHooks and runSecurityCodePass
tasks.summary: runSecurityCodePass(repoPath, targets, modelSelection, round) dispatches the code-vulnerability pass via CliProvider.runReadOnlySession with s1's pinned modelId, using READ_ONLY_SESSION_READ_TOOLS + READ_ONLY_SESSION_ANALYZE_TOOLS only, returning structured SecurityFinding[]. buildSecurityRoundHooks(repoPath, targets, modelSelection, reviewId) returns a RoundDriverHooks<SecurityFinding> with reviewKind:'code', checkpointGranularity:'round', ground:async()=>[] (a true no-op, no I/O), and security bound to runSecurityCodePass with these closed-over args -- matching the LLD's chosen alternative a1 exactly (hooks.security is the real adapter, hooks.ground is the documented no-op).
acceptanceChecks: buildSecurityRoundHooks's returned hooks.ground always resolves to [] without performing any I/O
buildSecurityRoundHooks's returned hooks.security delegates to runSecurityCodePass bound to the exact repoPath/targets/modelSelection/reviewId the factory was called with

a ReadOnlySessionTimeoutError from runReadOnlySession propagates out of runSecurityCodePass unchanged, never internally retried

tests.name: buildSecurityRoundHooks: hooks.ground always resolves to [] without I/O; hooks.security delegates to the injected code-pass function

tasks.title: Implement assembleSecurityReport
tasks.summary: Pure function folding s2's SecurityAdvisoryEvidence (confirmed matches, unresolvedDependencies, unavailableSources), round 2's code findings, the reconciliation result, both rounds' persisted VerificationReceipts, and the dispatched modelSelection into one in-memory SecurityReviewReport. Round-1 and round-2 code findings get their OWN round's receipt.id; dependency-advisory findings get no receiptId at all (never produced by either round's CLI execution). effectiveModel is copied verbatim from modelSelection as-dispatched, never re-resolved.
acceptanceChecks: confirmed advisoryEvidence.matches map to dependency-advisory SecurityFindings with checkId:'dependency-advisory' and NO receiptId set
round-1 code findings carry receiptId === receipts.round1.id; round-2 code findings carry receiptId === receipts.round2.id
unresolvedDependencies and unavailableSources pass through verbatim onto the returned SecurityReviewReport
empty advisoryEvidence.matches and empty codeFindings together produce an empty findings array, never an error
effectiveModel on the returned report equals modelSelection exactly as passed in, even when it differs from the repo's currently-configured tier default

tests.name: assembleSecurityReport: confirmed matches map to dependency-advisory SecurityFindings with checkId:'dependency-advisory'; unresolvedDependencies/unavailableSources pass through verbatim; empty inputs produce an empty findings array
assembleSecurityReport leaves receiptId unset on every dependency-advisory finding, and sets it only on the code findings produced by the matching round

tasks.title: Implement runSecurityReview
tasks.summary: The Story's orchestrator: binds the entire call inside runInStepContext({...currentStepContext(), cwd:repoPath, envRepo:repoPath}, ...) (spreading the outer context first so an already-bound connectionExecution/client survive); checks targets.entries path containment synchronously before any I/O; refuses before any round on modelSelection.status:'unavailable' (SecurityModelUnavailableError) or on verifyContentIdentityMatch's failure; generates one fresh attemptId (randomBytes(8).toString('hex')) per call; drives round 1 and round 2 via runReviewRound with hooks from buildSecurityRoundHooks, reconciling with reconcileRound and writing a checkpoint after each; persists ONE VerificationReceipt per round under id `{reviewId}-{attemptId}-round-{round}` (via persistVerificationReceipt, using deriveReceiptIdentity's output when epicHash/storyId are not supplied on the call), with a per-round try/catch that persists a 'fail' receipt before rethrowing on that round's own execution failure; reverifies contentIdentity a second time before round 2 and a third time before final persistence, aborting with ContentIdentityMismatchError on any divergence; calls assembleSecurityReport and renderReviewReport, then finalizeAndCleanup on success.
acceptanceChecks: a targets.entries path resolving outside repoPath throws synchronously before computeContentIdentity, any CLI dispatch, or any receipt persistence is attempted

the entire call body runs under a step context bound to {cwd:repoPath, envRepo:repoPath} while preserving an outer connectionExecution exactly as src/shared/step-context.ts's own runInStepContext spread pattern requires -- a case with a REAL bound connectionExecution set beforehand (mirroring a genuine attached caller) succeeds, not just the unbound ambient-cwd case
refuses before any round dispatches when modelSelection.status is 'unavailable', throwing SecurityModelUnavailableError with the blockerReason, and the fake CLI session is never called
refuses before any round dispatches when the pre-flight verifyContentIdentityMatch fails, and no receipt is persisted

persists exactly ONE VerificationReceipt per round (round1, round2), each 'pass' on a clean run; a round's own execution failure persists only that round's 'fail' receipt and never dispatches a later round

reverifies contentIdentity immediately before round 2 and immediately before final persistence; a content change injected between round 1 and round 2 in a test fixture is caught and aborts with ContentIdentityMismatchError, with round 1's receipt already durably persisted as 'pass'

two sequential calls with the SAME reviewId -- the first failing a round, the second succeeding -- persist TWO distinct receipts per round slot (different attemptId), both independently readable via readReceiptRecord; the first attempt's 'fail' receipt is never overwritten
run with repoPath=B while the test harness's own ambient cwd is A: every nested helper (checkpoint, reconciliation, report render, cleanup) reads/writes under B only, never A

epicHash/storyId supplied on the call are threaded directly into persistVerificationReceipt's ident with standalone left unset; when omitted, deriveReceiptIdentity's output is used with standalone:true
on success both round receipts exist and finalizeAndCleanup has run; on a pre-flight refusal, neither a receipt nor a checkpoint exists

tasks.title: Implement handleSecurityReviewStep + SecurityReviewStepRequest/Response types
tasks.summary: The sc3 entry-point body: on a fresh phase:'start' request, checks resolveRepoLastIndexedAt(repoPath) against the request's targets and returns {next:'confirm_wait', state, guidance} when stale and the caller has not said proceed; otherwise (or on a resumed call) resolves s1's SecurityModelSelection (resolveSecurityModel) and s2's SecurityAdvisoryEvidence (collectDependencyAdvisories) itself, then calls t4's runSecurityReview and returns {next:'done', report, markdown}. This is the ONLY function that owns the review's end-to-end sequencing of s1+s2+s3; the daemon IPC method and the MCP tool are both thin wrappers over it (t6).
acceptanceChecks: a fresh request against a repo with a FRESH index reaches {next:'done'} directly, never confirm_wait
a fresh request against a repo with a STALE index returns {next:'confirm_wait', state, guidance} without running resolveSecurityModel, collectDependencyAdvisories, or any round
a resumed call ({phase:'start', state, proceed:true}) waits for the index before running the review end-to-end to done
a resumed call ({phase:'start', state, proceed:false}) runs the review against the index as-is (a degraded run) and still reaches done with a fully populated report
epicHash/storyId supplied on the ORIGINAL request are passed straight through into runSecurityReview's opts unchanged, never re-derived or second-guessed here
ContentIdentityMismatchError and SecurityModelUnavailableError from runSecurityReview propagate out of handleSecurityReviewStep unchanged

tests.name: handleSecurityReviewStep: a stale-index fresh request returns confirm_wait with a state token, never runs a round; a resumed call with proceed:true or proceed:false both reach done; epicHash/storyId supplied on the request are threaded into the persisted receipt unchanged, while an omitted pair is derived via deriveReceiptIdentity with standalone:true
